min_standing_note.value: Must have completed at least 2 semesters at home institution before exchange arrival.

excluded_majors.notes: No academic majors excluded; only preparatory English courses, Teacher's License courses, and required degree-seeking non-content courses are closed (PDF p.2).

min_gpa_host.notes: Minimum cumulative GPA 2.5 on a 4.0 scale (from official transcript).

instruction_languages.notes: English for all subject-matter courses; Japanese language and Teacher's License courses excepted.

english_course_availability.notes: All subject-matter courses in the Faculty of International Liberal Arts are taught in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT 71 or IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) for non-native English speakers.

host_language_requirement.value: None required; Japanese language courses offered from beginner to advanced levels (advanced Japan Studies electives may require Japanese).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Arrival Aug 25, Orientation Aug 25-31, Classes Sep 2 - Dec 23, 2026 (Finals Dec 17-23, 2026).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester runs early April to late July (AY 2020-2021 reference: Arrival Apr 1, Orientation Apr 2-7, Classes Apr 9 - Jul 29, Finals Jul 23-29; Winter program Jan-Mar open to Fall attendees).

tuition_model.notes: Official partner nominees receive tuition and processing fee waivers.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from AY 2020-2021 Fact Sheet p.3 exact printed semester items divided by 5 months: Min = Komachi Residence 90,000 + Bedding & Cleaning 20,000 + Initial 2-wk meal plan 14,670 + 10-meal plan 60,000 + Textbooks 15,000 = 199,670 JPY / 5 = 39,934 JPY/mo; Max = Sakura Village (Fall) 184,000 + Bedding & Cleaning 20,000 + Initial 2-wk meal plan 14,670 + 21-meal plan 102,690 + Textbooks 50,000 = 371,360 JPY / 5 = 74,272 JPY/mo (excludes refundable 20,000 JPY deposit and 20,000 JPY activity fee; newer aiu.ac.jp pages cite textbooks ~50,000-70,000 JPY and housing ~130,000-215,000+ JPY/semester).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly JPY range 39,934-74,272 (midpoint 57,103.0)/month. ECB cross-rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 176.83 JPY -> 1 JPY = 0.006250 USD (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 57,103.0 JPY * 5 * 0.006250 = 1,784.49 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: General deposit 20,000 JPY (partly refundable), International student activity fee 20,000 JPY/semester (non-refundable), initial 2-week meal plan 14,670 JPY (2020-21 PDF p.3); mandatory Japanese National Health Insurance plus Gakkensai/Inbound Futai-Gakuso insurance per aiu.ac.jp/en/st/financial/.

housing_availability.notes: All international students are required to live in guaranteed on-campus housing (Komachi Hall, Global Village, University Village, or Sakura Village); homestay unavailable.

housing_notes.value: Komachi Hall 90,000 JPY/sem, Global Village 108,000-112,000 JPY/sem, University Village 108,000-114,000 JPY/sem, Sakura Village 180,000-184,000 JPY/sem + 20,000 JPY bedding/cleaning fee in 2020-21 PDF p.3; newer rates ~130,000-215,000+ JPY/sem on aiu.ac.jp/en/campuslife/housing/.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No AIU incoming exchange stipend verified in local PDF or official aiu.ac.jp results.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Requires Japanese Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) and Student Visa processed after AIU application.

course_catalog_url.notes: Updated exchange academics portal also at https://web.aiu.ac.jp/en/st/academic/.

english_course_list_url.notes: All subject-matter courses listed via https://web.aiu.ac.jp/en/academic/ and https://web.aiu.ac.jp/en/st/academic/ are taught in English; schedules hosted in ATOMS portal.

credit_system_and_load.value: US-style semester credits (1 lecture cr = 15 class hrs; 50-min hours). Minimum 12 credits (required by Japanese immigration law), standard 15 credits (~5 x 3-credit courses), maximum 18 credits/semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Preparatory English courses, Teacher's License courses, and required non-content courses for degree-seeking students are closed to incoming exchange students.

value: Completed signed Application Form with Confirmation Sheet
Evidence of Financial Support (for visa CoE)

academic_style.value: Small liberal arts seminar/discussion classes averaging 18 students per class (Faculty of International Liberal Arts); 1 class hr = 50 min with expectation of 2 hrs independent prep per class hr.

city_tier.notes: Located in Yuwa, Akita City; official city population tier figure not cited on aiu.ac.jp.

campus_type.notes: aiu.ac.jp explicitly describes Yuwa, Akita as having 'the welcoming, friendly community you'd expect in a rural setting' surrounded by nature.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: On-campus instruction and residential community use English (PDF p.1), while off-campus rural Akita is Japanese-speaking; overall local daily-life level unverified.

international_support_services.value: Center for International Affairs inbound exchange team, free arrival shuttle pickup from Akita Airport/JR station, orientation week, and residential life support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall semester: Nomination Feb 1 - Feb 20, Application Feb 1 - Apr 1; Spring semester: Nomination Sep 1 - Sep 20, Application Sep 1 - Nov 1.
